_source.method: Hand transcription from full-resolution crops; JSON generated by a session-scratchpad script (rsg/build_rsg.py, validated by rsg/validate_rsg.py against counters.json); only names and numbers were taken from the charts.

_scope: Base game only: German, Russian (Soviet), American. Mediterranean nations (Britain, France, Italy) appear in the 2025 playbook tables and leader/modifier columns; their table cells are kept only where they are a possible die-roll result (year table, Allied-nationality table) and are otherwise omitted (see _omitted).
_id_convention: Counter ids are the exact `name` strings in design/data/counters.json nations.<German|Russian|American>.{leaders,squads,teams,weapons}; fortification ids are counters.json markers.fortifications[].name (Minefield carries a separate firepower 6/7/8). Chart labels that differ from the counter id are kept in `chart_label` / `chart_row_to_counter`.

_version_comparison.result: No data differences found between the 2006 and 2025 OOB and Support charts for German, Russian and American: every dates/point/initiative/orders/quality cell, every unit/weapon count, every surrender level, and every Support Table cost/date cell is identical. Differences are cosmetic only (higher resolution, copyright year/footer code 0609 vs 2511, the Russian chart files renamed 'Soviet' while the chart title still says RUSSIAN). The 2025 versions were transcribed and the 2006 ones used as an independent second read.
_version_comparison.leader_and_fortification_table: No CC:E-2006 (3-nation) leader/fortification chart is in the module. All four copies present (RSG Leaders and Fortifications.png / -1.png / .jpg and the older scan RSG Leader Table.jpg) carry identical leader names, modifiers, fortification contents and VP costs.
_version_comparison.procedure: Only the 2025 (20th Anniversary) playbook is in reference/rules; the original 2006 CC:E playbook RSG is not available, so procedure tables are 2025-only. The 2025 RS.7 text itself states two changes from earlier editions: multiple Support purchases (even of the same item) are now allowed, and Radios can no longer be bought at RS.7 (only at RS.11.1 Asset Request).
_version_comparison.not_checked: CCE-RSG.vmdx (VASSAL RSG helper extension) was not downloaded, so it was not compared.

_validation: Every counter id used (OOB rows, Support items, Leader Table, design-your-own keys) exists in counters.json for that nation; German chart row 'Parachute Squad' = counters.json 'Fallschirmjager Squad' (same 5-4-5 / morale 8 icon); 'Light MG'/'Medium MG'/'Heavy MG' = LMG/MMG/HMG; 'Lieutenant von Karsties' = 'Lt Von Karsties'. Unit icon values printed on the charts (FP/range/move/morale, weapon penalties, radio FP) agree with counters.json.

No chart prints totals. Cross-check used instead: playbook p.35 says Surrender = 70% (Coy) / 75% (Det) / 80% (Plt) of leaders+squads+teams. All 81 OB sizes match that to within rounding; the 11 exact .5 cases round either way (up: German D Coy, E Coy, E Det; Russian S Det; American T Det. Down: German F Det; Russian X Det, Y Det; American V Det, Z Coy, Z Det). One cell is off by more than rounding: Russian T Det. prints 9 for 13 units (9.75). It was re-checked on both the 2006 and 2025 charts and is as printed.

Every OB has leaders 3/2/1 and orders 4/3/2 (Coy/Det/Plt) and strictly decreasing point values. Company squad counts match the p.35 hint (German 9, American 12, Russian 15) except Russian S and T (14) and American U (9).

Every (nation, year, quality) result reachable from the year, Allied-nationality and troop-quality tables has at least one matching OB. No Support column offers more than one Radio in any year. Every Support column offers at least one non-Radio item in every year the nation has OBs.

Leader Table: the 8 leaders per nation and the 9 Support-table leaders are disjoint and, with the Hero and the Private, account for all 19 leaders in counters.json. Morale rises (never falls) down each Leader Table column.

procedure_tables._note: Numbers/results from the 2025 playbook RSG chapter (RS.1-RS.16), with short paraphrased labels; the prose procedure lives in design/scenarios-reference.md. 'roll' = sum of the white and coloured dice (2-12) unless stated.

map_choice_roll.odd: the other player picks the map

rs1_battlefield.friendly_edge_roll: player who did not pick the map rolls and uses EITHER die (1-6); that compass direction faces him
rs1_battlefield.orientation_interpretation: wide = friendly edge is top/bottom (15-hex long edge, 10 rows deep); narrow = left/right (10-hex short edge, 15 columns deep). Inferred from maps.json board_edges and the 8-of-10 / 12-of-15 setup depths; the playbook does not define the terms.

procedure_tables.rs2_1_side: coin flip: heads = Axis, tails = Allies

rs2_2_allied_nationality_vs_german._note: roll -> year -> Allied nation. French/British results fall outside the base game; the playbook's Combat School tips (p.30) allow players to simply choose nationalities instead of rolling.

rs5_order_of_battle.vp_effect: each side moves the VP marker its OB point_value toward the opponent

rs6_leaders.rolls: one per OB leader, white die only, plus modifiers

rs7_support.who_first: player with the lower-cost OB (VP marker on his side)
rs7_support.purchase: one or more non-Radio items from the rolled column, matching the year and countermix; repeats allowed
rs7_support.cost: vp_cost moves the VP marker toward the opponent
rs7_support.second_player_rolls_only_if: after the first purchase the VP marker has crossed 0 to the second player's side

rs9_fortifications.budget: up to his current VP total
rs9_fortifications.minefields: all purchased Minefield OBs must share one strength

rs13_recon_each_side.order: higher OB initiative sets up first

rs11_1_asset_request.purchase: one Radio only, from the rolled Support column, if one matches the year

rs14_markers.sudden_death_space: Axis OB orders + Allied OB orders (playbook: 3-10 across all nations; 4-8 with base-game OBs, all orders 4/3/2)
rs14_markers.surrender_marker: OB surrender_level on own side of the Casualty Track
rs14_markers.minefield_strength_marker: 6 by default; 7 or 8 if a 7-/8-FP Minefield OB was bought
rs14_markers.smoke_blaze: all Smoke/Blaze markers into a draw cup

rs15_cards.initiative_card: player with the higher OB initiative (tie not covered by the playbook)

order_of_battle._note: Keyed by chit letter, then size (Coy = Company, Det = Detachment, Plt = Platoon). years = OB 'Dates Available' (inclusive). point_value = VP purchase cost (RS.5). initiative = RS.13/RS.15 comparison number. orders = Orders value placed on the OB Display (hand size comes from posture, see procedure_tables.rs15_cards). weapons_by_year = a cell printed with a date note (only German F Coy.: 3 Light Mortars in 1939-43, or 2 Medium Mortars in 1944-45).

German.leaders_note: 'leaders' = number of rolls on the Leader Table (RS.6), not specific counters

support_tables._note: columns: die roll (2-12) -> the items printed in that column, in chart order (top to bottom), each with its VP cost (bold number) and the years it is available (inclusive). kinds: leader, leader_either (one OR the other named leader per purchase, never both: Consolidated FAQ 'RS.7 & the German Support Table'), unit_with_weapon (the weapon must be given to that unit at setup; an OB weapon cannot be given to a lone Support unit - RS.7 / rule 11.2), squad, radio (RS.11.1 Asset Request or the Reinforcements event only; not purchasable at RS.7). Other uses of these tables (free, one item, matching year): Reinforcements event E68 (any item, Radio allowed), Infiltration E59 and Hidden Unit action A35.4 (non-Radio only).

leader_table._note: RS.6: one roll per OB leader on the WHITE die only (1-6), plus modifiers; results <=0 and 7+ are table rows. Re-roll a leader already gained. Line OBs have no quality modifier (no row printed).

modifiers.year_null_means: printed '-' (the nation has no OBs that year)

fortification_obs._note: RS.9 (Defender only, budget = his VP total; any mix, countermix permitting). vp_cost moves the VP marker toward the Attacker. 'sets' x 'per_set' = contents: e.g. Bunker Complex is printed '3x Bunker + Trench + Wire + Mines (8-FP)', read as three of each (same notation as Strongpoint '1x Bunker + Trench').
not_offered: Pillbox (counters.json has it; no Fortification OB contains one)

design_your_own_point_values._note: Playbook p.34 'Design-your-own Point Values' (not an RSG step; for building custom scenarios). Base-game columns only. Squad entries are listed under the playbook's Elite/Line/Green squad rows. null = no value printed for that nation.

playbook_p35_design_hints._note: Numbers from 'Scenario Design Hints' (playbook p.35), paraphrased labels.
playbook_p35_design_hints.weapon_teams: about one per HMG, Medium Mortar or Gun
